start_here: Say to your AI: "Run workflow:run-each-command-in-a-shared-space-exactly-once with store {\"where\": \"postgresql database example_shop on my own computer\", \"language\": \"SQL (PostgreSQL)\", \"credential_name\": \"example-shop-postgres-connection\"} and command_key c1 and command 'Add the member to the shared list'."
no_lists_because: It names no list: the receipts are kept in the person's own store, in whatever form that store keeps things, and store says where and in which language.
instructions: 1. Keep the store's login in your vault under a name you choose, and say where the store is and how it is spoken to.
2. Say "Run workflow:run-each-command-in-a-shared-space-exactly-once" with store, the command key, the command and, when it ends, its outcome.
3. The first run makes the receipts table once and proves it on the example commands; every attempt must come out as the prove step says, or the run stops and says which.
4. Every later run answers the command from its receipt and asks the person before it runs a command whose receipt is unsure.

worked_examples.title: A new command runs once
worked_examples.ask: Add the member to the shared list, key c1.

store.where: postgresql database example_shop on my own computer

input.command: Add the member to the shared list

worked_examples.hands_back: outcome "run", state "started"; once it ends the receipt is "done".

worked_examples.title: The same command again runs nothing
worked_examples.ask: Add the member to the shared list again, key c1.

store.where: postgresql database example_shop on my own computer

input.command: Add the member to the shared list

worked_examples.title: An unsure command is asked again

store.where: postgresql database example_shop on my own computer

worked_examples.hands_back: outcome "asked", state "unsure", and nothing run until the person answers.
